records.command: for f in dist/*.js dist/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done
for f in scripts/*.sh; do bash -n "$f"; done
for f in dist/*.php; do php -l "$f"; done

scope: All 35 mandatory verify checks, plus navigation/motion/characters regressions on exact application candidate. The full 38-suite browser matrix remains required in production CI.

focused_browser.result: Initial pre-generation PASS; CI then exposed build integration failure, superseded by post-generation PASS described below.
focused_browser.evidence: Real summary/card entry, six original atlas cells/modes, actual mobile start visible and focus on game, error/correct/progress, close/reopen, owned avatar/crown vs temporary preview, wallet preserved.
Eight default worlds, twenty portraits, real targets/replay, actor rectangles do not overlap targets, original artwork, guest no API writes, retained classic option.
Eight real objects/animations, actual local page football/space tap, reduced motion/pause, rapid clicks, replay chest reset, cleanup, no API writes.

independent_review: No remaining static blocker identified after fixes to replay visual state and duplicate fallback avatar.
privacy: Synthetic fixtures only. No real accounts, children data, membership, permissions, API or hosting configuration changed.
limits: Local Chromium; not proof of original tablet compatibility or real audio pronunciation.
Illustrated portraits remain animated pawns; existing physical accessories/furniture remain reachable through classic3D.
No claim that tests cover every possible user interaction.
